page.overview:
Who is Beth?

Warren Ampersand (ancestor) Joshua (ancestor)

She and Shermy appear to live in Marceline's now-abandoned house, similar to how Finn and Jake lived in the Tree House, which also originally belonged to Marceline. She is a descendant of Jake and Lady Rainicorn.

As a descendent of Jake and Lady Rainicorn, Beth is a large, round, light yellow pup with similar eyes, ears, and jowls. She also has a white horn on top of her head and lacks a visible nose. She also has a large belly button - the main source of her power.

Beth's special ability relies on her stretchy and rather swollen belly button, which when opened, can form a kind of portal that can either transport objects or creatures elsewhere or bring them to her. She can seemingly stretch out her navel with her bare hands to no limit in order to fit objects of any size and often uses it as storage.
